descriptionChirho: The proper name Basemath (Hebrew בָּשְׂמַת, 'fragrant'), borne by two women in Genesis: (1) Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite, one of Esau's wives (Genesis 26:34); (2) Basemath daughter of Ishmael, also a wife of Esau (Genesis 36:3-4, 10, 13, 17). The two sense clusters differ only by the prefixed conjunction waw ('and Basemath') versus the bare name. Uniformly rendered: English 'Basemath', Spanish 'Basmat/Basemat', Hindi बासमत/बास्मात, Arabic باسمَةَ/بَسْمَتَ, Korean 바슸마, Swahili 'Basimati'. All 7 occurrences are in Genesis patriarchal narratives.
